description: This file defines the Document entity class within a document management system. It includes fields like parent entity info, file details, size, type, description, location, and storage type. The class provides methods for creation, updating, and accessor methods for these properties.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Entity class representing a document with metadata like name, type, size, location, and storage info. It extends AbstractPersistableCustom for persistence capabilities.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new Document instance with specified properties.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Update the document's properties based on the provided DocumentCommand object.

methods.name: getParentEntityType
methods.description: Returns the type of the parent entity to which this document is associated.

methods.name: setParentEntityType
methods.description: Sets the type of the parent entity.

methods.name: getParentEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the parent entity.

methods.name: setParentEntityId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the parent entity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the document.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the document.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the document.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the document.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location of the document.

methods.name: storageType
methods.description: Returns the StorageType instance corresponding to the storage type enum value.
